calibration_status: SIMULATOR_ONLY_UNCALIBRATED (friction coefficients, contact stiffness and dashpot ratios are declared numerical / illustrative values, not measured)

common.law_definition: per reference-grid node with mass (TLMPM nodes are the Q1 material points; the strip lies on the particle lattice so the outer nodes are on the faces), x_I = X_I + u_I (u_I float64, advanced with the drift velocity); every penetrated obstacle (gap < 0 at the start of the substep): F_n = max(k_n (-gap) - c_n v_n, 0), k_n = kappa_n m_I / dt^2, c_n = 2 zeta_n sqrt(k_n m_I); one Coulomb spring-dashpot-slider on the deepest obstacle: F_t = -k_t xi_t - c_t v_t capped at mu F_n (slip: the anchor slides, xi_t = -F_t / k_t), k_t = kappa_t m_I / dt^2, c_t = 2 zeta_t sqrt(k_t m_I); v = the node's predicted (post-force) velocity relative to the obstacle point; the impulse dt (F_n + F_t) enters the kick after the P2G grid update; xi_t += dt (v_I - v_obs) after the drift; a node leaving contact or changing obstacle releases its anchor; nodes of an active Dirichlet group are skipped
common.law_parameter_status: declared numerical values chosen from the DIAGNOSTIC probes (ADR 0023 section 22.1: probe_contact_laws_003/004 and the stiffness / damping sweeps); not fitted to any formal scene below
common.contact_work: kick_average_v1: W_n, W_t = sum J . (g_n + g_{n+1}) / 2 with g_n = old after the P2G grid update and g_{n+1} = old after the final MUSL grid update; obstacle power P = sum J . v_obs; D_contact = (P_n - W_n) + (P_t - W_t)
common.books_layer_N: B(t) = E_kin + Psi_eq + E_grav + W_b - W_ext - (W_n + W_t), all from the reset state (E_kin particle KE, Psi_eq the equilibrium free energy = the frozen elastic energy for elastic materials, W_b the kick-paired Prony branch work with visco_energy = branch_work_kick_average_v2, W_ext the traction and Dirichlet work with traction_work = grid_displacement_v1 and constraint_work = kick_average_v1)
common.solver: single env: LiveRubberMaterial(contact=ContactSpec(...)) -> TLMPMRubberContact (the TLMPMRubberVisco / tlmpm_rubber_v1 launch sequence plus the contact launches); batched: BatchedRubberMaterial with the contact option (RUBBER-CONT-08/-09)
common.step_rule: dt = control_dt / ceil(control_dt / (cfl dx / c_p)), c_p with mu0 (instantaneous modulus)
common.loading: gravity and tractions ramped with 1/2 (1 - cos(pi t / T_ramp)) and updated every SUBSTEP on the CPU (quasi-static: a step load on an undamped elastic body overshoots by 2 and unloads its contacts periodically)
common.artificial_damping: none in the material; the contact law's declared dashpots act only on contact nodes and their dissipation is booked as contact dissipation (never as material or viscoelastic damping)
common.device: CPU (Warp) for RUBBER-CONT-01..07 and -10; GPU0 for -09 / -11

INC.what: block on an inclined table: strip-local block 16 x 8 x 4 mm, n_t 3 (dx 4/3 mm), case free, corner at the origin; table plane z = 0 (normal +z); gravity 9.81 (sin theta, 0, -cos theta) (the incline as a tilted gravity); friction friction_table = mu

PEN.what: block 8 x 6 x 4 mm, case free, on a FRICTIONLESS table z = 0 (uniform base pressure), Prony P2 material, gravity -z, top traction pressure p (traction group: the top particle layer) ramped over 20 ms; mean node displacements over [0.04, 0.06] s

IMP.what: rod 40 x 4 x 4 mm along x, case free, no gravity, uniform initial velocity -0.3 m/s along x onto the FRICTIONLESS wall x = 0 (normal +x; the rod's end face starts on the wall)
IMP.reference: 1-D elastic rod on a rigid frictionless wall: contact duration 2 L / c0, c0 = sqrt(E_eff / rho), E_eff = 9 kappa mu0 / (3 kappa + mu0); rebound velocity = impact velocity (energy-conserving)

PINCH.what: case A strip, free length L 30 mm, W 10 mm, t 4 mm, n_t 3, jaw 2 dx clamped (group 0, F8 projection, kick-average work, held fixed); two pad frames of kind pad (friction_pad = mu_pad): top box x in [L - 8, L + 2] mm, y in [-2, W + 2] mm, z in [t, t + 2] mm, bottom box mirrored below z = 0; elastic material; no gravity
PINCH.design_estimate: uniaxial squeeze pressure E_eff 2 delta / t gives mu_pad (N_top + N_bottom) ~ 0.95 / 1.9 / 2.85 N, reached after ~0.5 / 1.1 / 1.6 mm of the 5 mm pull (axial stiffness ~1.8 kN/m)
PINCH.slip_detection: tip-marker velocity along x below 0.5 x pull speed while the pads move: slip; the sustained-slip window is the last 10 ms of the pull

COUPLE.what: case A cantilever strip W 10 mm, t 4 mm, n_t 3, no gravity, jaw group 0 = the hand (F8 projection, kick-average work); a 1-DOF hand surrogate along z: m_h z'' = k_h (z_c - z) + c_h (z_c' - z') + F_strip,z(delayed), c_h = 2 zeta_h sqrt(k_h m_h), zeta_h 0.7, integrated with 0.05 ms symplectic-Euler substeps in both arms; command z_c: smootherstep of 5 mm over T_m, then hold; total 0.6 s; elastic material

arms.A_delayed_20ms: control interval 20 ms; the material follows the hand pose of interval k (linear within the interval) and its interval-averaged wrench is applied to the hand ODE during interval k + 1 (the Phase 1 pending_wrench handoff)
arms.B_reference_1ms: control interval 1 ms, the same handoff (delay 1 ms)

RUBBER-CONT-01.name: incline: stick below and Coulomb slip above tan theta = mu, slip onset at tan theta = mu
RUBBER-CONT-01.reference: rigid-body Coulomb: stick (a = 0) for tan theta < mu; a = g (sin theta - mu cos theta) for tan theta > mu; with a/(g cos theta) = tan theta - mu the onset is the zero of the linear slip branch

criteria.a_stick: every stick run (both mu, ratios 0.6 and 0.85, and the P2 row at 0.95): |x_cm(end) - x_cm(0.02 s)| <= stick_disp_rel * s (s = particle spacing) and |a_fit| <= stick_acc_rel * g cos theta (quadratic fit of x_cm on the fit window)
criteria.b_slip: every slip run: |a_fit - g (sin theta - mu cos theta)| <= slip_acc_rel * g cos theta
criteria.c_onset: per mu: linear least-squares fit of a_fit / (g cos theta) against tan theta over the three slip runs; its zero mu_eff satisfies |mu_eff / mu - 1| <= onset_rel
criteria.d_books: every run: max_t |B(t)| <= books_rel * S, S = max_t (E_kin + Psi) + max_t |E_grav(t)|; books_order_row: max |B| at cfl 0.25 <= ratio_max * max |B| at cfl 0.5, or both <= floor_rel * S
criteria.e_validity: no invalid flag (nonfinite, J domain, CFL guard) in any run

RUBBER-CONT-01.rationale: probe_contact_laws_004 (12 x 6 x 3 mm block, mu 0.5, seen before declaration): stick creep <= 1e-6 m at ratios 0.8 / 0.9 vs >= 2e-3 m of slip; slip error 0.1-0.5 % of g cos theta at 1.15-1.25; the elastic block at ratio 0.95 creeps (friction-induced flutter of the HF-undamped elastic model, ADR 0023 section 22.1) and is therefore NOT a scored stick row for the elastic material; the P2 material held at 0.95 in the diagnostic sweep and is scored

RUBBER-CONT-02.name: penetration vs grid / dt refinement
RUBBER-CONT-02.reference: the law: at a static fixed point a node carries F_I = k_n delta_I + 2 zeta_n sqrt(kappa_n) F_I (the dashpot sees the predicted velocity -dt F_I / m_I), so delta_I = (1 - 2 zeta_n sqrt(kappa_n)) F_I / k_n proportional to dt^2 / dx at fixed pressure and CFL (delta -> 0 under refinement); undamped variant: delta_I = F_I / k_n exactly

criteria.a_bound: every resolution: max node penetration over the window <= pen_max_rel * s
criteria.b_dt: mean interior-face-node penetration: delta(n_t 2, cfl 0.25) / delta(n_t 2, cfl 0.5) in dt_ratio_band (law: 0.25)
criteria.c_dx: delta(n_t 4, cfl 0.5) / delta(n_t 2, cfl 0.5) in dx_ratio_band (law: 0.5)
criteria.d_law: undamped variant: sum over face nodes of k_n delta_I = table reaction within law_rel, and the mean interior-face delta_I / (p A_I / k_n) within law_rel_node
criteria.e_balance: every run: mean table reaction over the window = weight + p A within balance_rel

RUBBER-CONT-03.name: normal impact and rebound: energy accounting with contact work, elastic energy and viscoelastic dissipation separated

criteria.a_books: every run: max_t |B(t)| <= books_rel * E0 (E0 = 1/2 M V^2) and |B(end)| <= books_end_rel * E0; elastic and P2 at n_t 4: max |B| at cfl 0.25 <= ratio_max * max |B| at cfl 0.5 (first order) or both <= floor_rel * E0
criteria.b_contact_time: elastic, n_t 4, cfl 0.5: first to last substep-sampled contact (any normal impulse in a control step) t_c satisfies |t_c / (2 L / c0) - 1| <= tc_rel
criteria.c_attribution: every run, after separation: the energy missing from E_kin + Psi_eq is exactly the booked dissipation: D_contact = -(W_n + W_t) >= 0 (static wall) and, with Prony terms, D_b = W_b - Psi_v >= 0 (branch work minus the stored branch energy); D_contact / E0 <= contact_loss_max at n_t 4 (reported with its normal / tangential split; the wall is frictionless, so the tangential part is ~0)
criteria.d_convergence: elastic, cfl 0.5: D_contact(n_t 4) <= conv_ratio_max * D_contact(n_t 2) (the declared dashpots act on the contact node layer, whose mass fraction is O(dx))
criteria.e_penetration: every run: max node penetration <= pen_max_rel * s
criteria.f_reported: rebound centroid velocity / V, the elastic vs P2 rebound, D_b / E0, the undamped-law rebound (probe) for comparison

RUBBER-CONT-03.rationale: probe (rod 30 x 4 x 4 mm, V 0.2 m/s, seen): books max 0.79 / 0.33 % at cfl 0.5 / 0.25, end 0.04 %, contact 1.92 ms vs 2L/c0 1.87 ms, contact dissipation 3.9 % of E0 at n_t 4

RUBBER-CONT-04.name: friction dissipation = mu N x slip distance
RUBBER-CONT-04.reference: rigid Coulomb sliding: dissipation = mu integral N dx_cm

criteria.a_total: every slip run: |D_contact / (mu sum_k N_k dx_cm,k) - 1| <= dissipation_rel, N_k the table normal force of control step k (wrench), dx_cm,k the centroid increment along the slope; D_contact = -(W_n + W_t) over the whole run
criteria.b_split: reported: Coulomb-slider, tangential-dashpot and normal-dashpot shares (sliding excites normal contact vibration that the normal dashpot dissipates; the tangential share alone is not the rigid-body value)

RUBBER-CONT-04.rationale: probe (seen): total interface dissipation / (mu integral N dx) = 0.97 / 0.99 / 0.99 at ratios 1.05 / 1.15 / 1.25 with N from the ramp formula; the tangential share alone 0.90-0.96

RUBBER-CONT-05.name: gripper pinch-and-pull: slip onset vs grip force, per-pad wrenches
RUBBER-CONT-05.reference: two-pad Coulomb: pull force T <= mu_pad (N_top + N_bottom), equality while the strip slips in the pads

criteria.a_slip_ratio: every squeeze depth: mean over the sustained-slip window of |T| / (mu_pad (N_top + N_bottom)) in slip_ratio_band (T = sum of the pads' x forces, N from the pads' z forces, all from the per-pad wrenches [F, B, 6])
criteria.b_cone: every control step of every run: |T| <= cone_tol * mu_pad (N_top + N_bottom) (no friction above the cone)
criteria.c_grip_scaling: the three depths give distinct N (each >= 1.3 x the previous) and their slip ratios agree within scaling_rel
criteria.d_balance: sustained-slip window: |F_x(clamp) + T| <= balance_rel * |T| (quasi-static; the strip's inertia is small)

RUBBER-CONT-06.name: self-contact (fold scene)
RUBBER-CONT-06.status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_V1: declared limitation (ADR 0023 section 22.3); not part of the P2-4 acceptance; reported as NOT_RUN
RUBBER-CONT-06.requirement_until_implemented: a fold must end in a flag (RUBBER-PHYS-12 guard / J domain) or be detected by the self-contact detector task (ADR 0023 section 22.8); fold scenes are outside the v1 domain

RUBBER-CONT-07.name: 20 ms delayed force handoff: coupling-delay assessment

metrics.e_tip: RMS_t (z_tip,A - z_tip,B) / peak-to-peak z_tip,B over the run
metrics.d_decay: |zeta_tip,A / zeta_tip,B - 1|, zeta from the logarithmic decrement of the tip oscillation peaks on [T_m + 0.1 s, end] (reported as NOT_RESOLVED when fewer than 3 peaks)
metrics.e_delay_energy: per arm: E_delay = sum_k (F_applied,k - F_material,k) . dz_h,k (the work the hand receives from the handed-off force minus the work the material force actually did over the same interval), relative to max_t (E_kin + Psi) of the strip

RUBBER-CONT-07.classification: an envelope point is coupling_delay_acceptable when e_tip <= tip_rel, d_decay <= decay_rel (or NOT_RESOLVED in both arms) and |E_delay,A| <= energy_rel; otherwise coupling_delay_significant (rows run there carry the label)

criteria.a_classified: every envelope point is run in both arms and classified
criteria.b_material_books: both arms, every point: max_t |B(t)| <= books_rel * S (S = max_t (E_kin + Psi) + max_t |W_ext|): the delay never enters the material's books
criteria.c_no_material_attribution: the delay energy error is reported on the hand side only; no material damping parameter is fitted or changed

RUBBER-CONT-07.note: kinematic-grip RL rows (backend kinematic_grip_batched, ideal tracking) have no wrench feedback and therefore no coupling delay error by construction

RUBBER-CONT-08.name: batched contact: L0 byte-wise and L1 isolation (CPU)

criteria.a_L0: N = 1 and N = 3 heterogeneous (geometry, mu_table, mu_pad, material incl. P2, planes, pad frames and their motions): every array of every env byte-identical to its single-env TLMPMRubberContact reference after every control step, including ct_node_u, ct_xi, ct_obst, ct_vobs, ct_work, reactions and the per-pad wrenches [N, G, B, 6]
criteria.b_L1: perturbing one env's input (pad motion, friction, plane) changes no byte of the other envs; masked partial reset of one env equals a fresh env (vars()-complete with the contact arrays) and evolves like one
criteria.c_refusals: mixed contact laws / parameters / obstacle counts in one batch are refused (UNSUPPORTED_NONUNIFORM_BATCH)

RUBBER-CONT-09.name: GPU per-env wrench and state isolation

criteria.a_zero_rows: N = 4 on GPU0, env 1 pinched by pads and resting on the table, envs 0 / 2 / 3 with their pads and planes out of reach: every contact row of envs 0 / 2 / 3 (plane and pad wrenches, contact work, penetration, event counts) is exactly 0.0 after every control step
criteria.b_perturbation_band: batch A vs batch B differing only in env 1's squeeze depth: for envs 0, 2, 3 every observable (markers, energies, wrenches) differs by at most the A vs A' repeat difference (same batch run twice) widened by 1e-6 relative
criteria.c_audits: env-ownership audits 0 (nodes, cells, markers, groups, tractions, contact rows); finite; invalid bits 0

RUBBER-CONT-10.name: contact off and law checks (CPU unit tests)

criteria.a_off: without a ContactSpec LiveRubberMaterial builds the unchanged TLMPMRubber / TLMPMRubberCW / TLMPMRubberVisco; with an empty ContactSpec every state array is byte-identical to TLMPMRubberVisco / the elastic solver after every control step (elastic and P2)
criteria.b_twins: float64 box SDF and Coulomb projection kernels equal their host references
criteria.c_law: static penetration law (RUBBER-CONT-02 d on a small block), conservative undamped normal law in a frictionless impact, reset clears every contact array and episodes repeat byte-wise

RUBBER-CONT-11.name: cost (reported, not scored)
RUBBER-CONT-11.measure: GPU0 single env and batched: ms per substep with and without contact (table plane + 2 pad frames), stage split of the contact kernels; SHARED_GPU labels, co-tenant samples, driver, dirty-tree flag and this protocol's sha256 in every row

seen_before_declaration: probe incline block 12 x 6 x 3 mm (n_t 3, mu 0.5, ratios 0.8 / 0.9 / 0.95 / 1.05 / 1.15 / 1.25)
probe rod 30 x 4 x 4 mm impact at 0.2 m/s (n_t 4)
unit-test blocks 6 x 4 x 2 mm and rods 12 x 2 x 2 mm (n_t 2)
provenance.rule: thresholds are never loosened after a result; a change is a v2 declared before its run; failures are preserved
